Good food
Aug 2025 • Friends
I visited this restaurant recently and had a very pleasant experience. The Mood is cozy, modern and well-treated, creating a comfortable space to enjoy the meal. The service was attentive and friendly, with the staff always available to clarify doubts and suggest dishes. The food exceeded expectations: fresh ingredients, well made and presented appealingly. The taste is balanced and the care is noted in every detail. The card offers varied options that please different tastes, including lighter alternatives and more traditional ones. The servings are generous and the price fair to the quality presented. The dessert was a highlight apart, ending the meal in a memorable way. The location is convenient and the space clean and organized, transmitting confidence. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant to those looking for good food, nice Mood and a quality Service. I intend to return soon to try other dishes.

A Fantastic Surprise in Central City
Aug 2024 • Couples
We stumbled onto this place because it was near our hotel, and wow, we were lucky! We have never had hot pot before, but the staff did not treat us like idiots, and they welcomed us in, and explained everything well. There was also some other customers next to us who helped out also, so it was very social! What can I say about the food - it was stunning. Beef, pork, fishballs, and loads of fresh veges, which we cooked in the broth in the middle of the table. It was yummy and very healthy. Thanks for your hospitality and we will be back next time we are in Ho Chi Minh City.
